name: Maasym
description: A star 113 parsecs away, 36 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: radius 35.546 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 352.896 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.065) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: effective temperature 4199 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.061)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 1.75 from 2024A&A...681A.107R; the 6 published values span log g 1.7496 to 2.55, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: distance 113.25 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.025), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 113 parsecs away, 36 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 353 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,199 K, so 35.546 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 85693: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Lambda Herculis
quotes.card: Lambda Herculis, formally named Maasym, is a star in the constellation of Hercules.
quotes.introduction: From parallax measurements taken during the Gaia mission, it is approximately 393 light-years from the Sun.
